cases.disposition_reason: Paused showcase --page hints --frame 0 --color truecolor --motion paused at 120×40. The motion row is below the fold. One wheel on Layers, amount 2, reveals Indexing idle. The spinner is ⠋, spinner_frame(0) (src/widgets/progress.rs). The painted motion-note prefix is full: the spinner turns. Two observations are cell-identical. The terminal then resizes to 80×24. The stored narrow frame is taken while the title Status & hints is still on screen, after two cell-identical observations, and before the return to 120×40. The narrow frame does not show the indexing row. The page returns to 120×40 with Indexing idle and ⠋, then finish() exits 0. check_stored compares those two stored frames. --frame 4 selects ⠼, which differs from ⠋, and two observations match. No third baseline. Reduced --frame 0 is idle on ⠋. Run job sets job to Some(0.0) (src/bin/showcase/pages/status_hints.rs). The indexing label leaves Indexing idle and the percent advances, while the spinner stays ⠋, because Reduced ticks and does not animate (src/motion.rs). Those moving frames are not stored. Full motion after Run job shows two different spinner glyphs. That frame is not stored: on_tick in src/bin/showcase/app.rs increments tick only while the page is animating and motion.animates(). Jackin --scenario launch-failure --motion paused, with the test clock on and no --frame. advance_clock(33) is one cockpit tick (rain::TICK_MS). LaunchRun::advance's first tick changes the activity from Preparing launch… to Resolving launch identity… (src/bin/jackin/sim/launch.rs). CockpitScreen::on_tick steps while clock.running, which clock::run_step sets for the paste (src/bin/jackin/screens/cockpit.rs, src/bin/jackin/app.rs). A second observation matches. The advance-clock paste is absent. No jackin baseline. Intro rain on_tick returns immediately while paused (src/bin/jackin/rain.rs). TablePro at 120×40 opens Filter connections under the TablePro header. The resting screen has no spinner. render_spinner runs only while Connecting (src/bin/tablepro/connections.rs). Paused and reduced text match. The resting screen does not move. Holla --scenario first-use paused shows discovering … · 0 of 6 with ⠋. Reduced sources_for zeroes source delays (src/bin/holla/domain/fixtures.rs), so that line is absent and there is no spinner. No extra baselines.
cases.action_sequence: Capture paused and reduced frames with the existing frame controls. Capture a Jackin phase with the clock hook. Do not add a Showcase clock hook.
cases.expected_results: Paused frames are stable. A Showcase transient that cannot be frozen is BLOCKED, not accepted as a changing baseline.
cases.forbidden_effects: A changing frame is stored as the expected image.
